question.text: An urn contains 8 red and 5 white balls. Three balls are drawn at random. Then, the probability that balls of both colours are drawn is

solution.text:
Total number of selections of three balls in which balls of both colours are drawn
$=2$ red balls and 1 white ball +1 red ball and 2 white balls
$\begin{array}{l}
={ }^{8} C_{2} \times{ }^{5} C_{1}+{ }^{8} C_{1} \times{ }^{5} C_{2} \\
=140+80=220
\end{array}$
$\therefore$ Required probability
$=\frac{220} {{ }^{13} C_{3}}=\frac{220 \times 6}{13 \times 12 \times 11}=\frac{10}{13}$
